properties.description: Bronze orchestrator. Runs every full-load ingest pipeline the bronze layer needs from a cold start: today that means weather backfill (mirrored SQL + clickstream eventstream are already live and don't need a kick). Designed to be the single 'first run' entry point and to grow new child ExecutePipeline activities as more sources arrive.

activities.name: Weather backfill and catchup
activities.description: Runs pl_bronze_weather_ingest, which calls Open-Meteo for every store's lat/long and merges the daily weather rows into contoso_retail_bronze.dbo.weather. waitOnCompletion=true so this orchestrator only finishes once weather is loaded; a future deploy can fan out additional sibling activities here in parallel.
